summary: Iterations pass from CLI into the selected spmvGpu<Width> specialization, and CSR initialization sets the final delimiter to n=floor(dim²/sparsity). Width 2/4/8/16/32 is selected by mean row length. The launch grid is capped at 32*SMs, while each kernel advances rows by gridDim*blockDim/Width to paddedRows and guards rows>=dim; every valid row traverses the full CSR interval in Width strides and lane 0 stores its result. A synchronized warmup precedes timing. Each compiled width branch records a start event, performs a counted loop of exactly iterations launches through its matching device stub, then records and synchronizes the end event. Each of the five called stubs reaches cudaLaunchKernel with the corresponding final kernel. All five selectable native sm86 kernels were inspected through the padded-row guard, CSR arithmetic loop/backedge, reduction, valid-row store and exit. No omission identified.
